interface.longDescription: A cross-stack toolkit of 81 self-contained skills for product, design, mobile/web engineering, data, AI, security, TDD, testing, adaptive HTTP compression and reliable releases. Compression guidance negotiates Zstd/Brotli/Gzip using Accept-Encoding rather than browser labels. Skills are instructions, not automatic execution or infrastructure.
defaultPrompt: Use DevFlowForge to research the users and design a new accessible SaaS dashboard with wireframes, design tokens and an implementation plan.
Audit this repository across architecture, security, product UX, performance and test coverage. Select only relevant skills and cite evidence.

Implement this feature using TDD: show a failing test, make the smallest fix, rerun unit and integration checks, and confirm release gates. Offer a scoped, authorized penetration test only if appropriate.

name: devflowforge
description: 81 portable engineering and design skills for AI coding assistants, including browser-aware HTTP compression, TDD, performance, testing and security.
